workload: MTP server (12 threads, ctx 32000, spec-draft-n-max 2), fixed prompt, 256 greedy tokens, sequential single runs

arm_a_baseline.evicted_bytes: all ffn_*_exps slices (madvise MADV_DONTNEED + posix_fadvise DONTNEED on file-backed gguf mappings, one pass between requests)

crashes.signature: double free or corruption (out) in cudaGraphExecDestroy (libcuda heap)
crashes.location: ~token 215-218 of the first request, always in runs where the drop pass really evicted pages

decision_note: No speed signal: kernel readahead already overlaps fault-fill with compute (consistent with EXP-012). The eviction hook destabilizes the CUDA driver. Warmer code removed from the runtime and integration patch. P1 closed.
